source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the basic mechanism of homeostasis (PDF 1-2).

blocks.text: Homeostasis teen ajza ke mil kar kaam karne se qaim rehta hai.

items: Receptors (sensors): organs, tissues, cells ya cell ke hisse jo tabdeeli pakar kar control centre ko maloomat bhejte hain, maslan jild mein darja-e-hararat ke receptors aur khoon ki nalyon mein dabao ke receptors.

Control centre: maloomat le kar process karta aur effectors ko paigham bhejta hai ta ke andaruni mahol set points ke gird tang had mein rahe; dimagh, spinal cord aur endocrine glands control centre ka kaam karte hain.

Effectors: muscles aur glands jo jawab dete hain, muscles sukar kar aur glands ifraz kar ke, aur set point bahal karte hain. Darja-e-hararat girne par kaampna (shivering) aur nalyon ka sukarna (vasoconstriction) hararat barhate aur hararat ka zaya kam karte hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: paanch dabbe, tabdeeli se receptors, control centre aur effectors ke zariye set point ki bahali tak, aur surkh line wapas shuru tak. Neeche baen: zyada garmi ka negative feedback loop, 37 C se zyada darja-e-hararat se paseene aur wapas 37 C tak. Neeche daen: bachche ki paidaish ka positive feedback loop, rahim ke sukarne se hypothalamus aur oxytocin ke zariye mazboot tar sukarne tak.
blocks.caption: Homeostasis ke ajza aur feedback ki do qismein (topic 13.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Andaruni ya bairooni mahol ki tabdeeli receptors pakarte aur hypothalamus jaise control centre ko batate hain; control centre effectors, yaani muscles ya glands, ko signal deta hai jin ka rad-e-amal jism ko set point par wapas lata hai, aur nateeja wapas receptors tak jata hai. Negative feedback mein nateeja signal band kar deta hai: darja-e-hararat 37 C se barhe to paseene ke glands paseena banate hain jab tak darja-e-hararat wapas na aaye aur receptors signal band na kar dein. Positive feedback mein nateeja signal ko mazboot karta hai: paidaish ke waqt rahim ke sukarne se oxytocin nikalta hai jo mazeed tez sukarne paida karta hai, jab tak bachcha paida na ho.

blocks.prompt: Thand ke din kaampte waqt receptor, control centre aur effector kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Receptors: jild aur hypothalamus ke darja-e-hararat ke receptors; control centre: hypothalamus; effectors: kaampne wale skeletal muscles (aur sukarne wali jild ki nalyan).

items: Receptors pakarte, control centre faisla karta, effectors jawab de kar set point bahal karte hain.
